items.title: Humana (HUM) Jumped, But What Is Drawing Fresh Attention Now?
items.summary: Humana (HUM) moved sharply higher this week after Barclays shifted its rating on the insurer to Overweight from Equalweight, indicating that the shares could outperform sector peers. At around US$397.93, Humana’s recent 4.63% 1 day share price return and 3.21% 30 day share price return build on a strong year to date share price return of 50.46%. items.title: Humana surges: Barclays bets big on Medicare star ratings rebound

items.title: Humana Jumps 7% on Barclays Upgrade and $515 Target; UnitedHealth Nudges Higher
